text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: service=inference-runtime-prod severity=P1 — 37 pages in 2m, auto-grouping triggered. Auto-escalation will run if no ack in 60s. Tags: paging_storm, dedupe_candidate

sara: acked. seeing repeated `Inference timeout` alerts across 3 hosts. I'm on it.

mohit: +1 ack. can someone confirm whether this is real customer impact or health-check noise?

james-support: getting 2 emails from enterprise-corp complaining about timeouts hitting their LLM endpoints ~2m ago. they reported higher latency not 5xxs.

kevin: likely cause: autoscaler churned a worker pool and healthchecks flooded PagerDuty because instance drain returned 503s and our incident-bot didn't dedupe per-instance. we pushed an emergency patch last week but maybe regression.

incident-bot: Note: suppression window currently 30s, threshold=5 alerts/60s for auto-suppress. This thread created to coordinate silences and prevent paging storms.

mohit: propose immediate short silence on service to stop duplication while we triage. will use pdctl to silence but will keep escalation channels open.

kevin: use this to create a short silence: ```bash
# create a 10m maintenance for inference-runtime-prod
pd maintenance-window create --service inference-runtime-prod --description "temp dedupe silence while investigating" --start "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --end "$(date -u -d '+10 minutes' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
```

sara: running it now.

sara: `pd maintenance-window create` returned id mw_5a7b. PagerDuty-bot: maintenance mw_5a7b created by sara (10m) — auto-silence active.

pagerduty-bot: Maintenance window mw_5a7b applied to service inference-runtime-prod. Suppressing new alerts from that service for 10 minutes.

mohit: good. while suppressed, check logs for the drain event. Sara — can you paste the k8s drain logs for the hosts referenced in alerts?

sara: grabbing logs. snippet: ```
I0314 18:15:23 kubelet.go:125] Evicting pod inference-worker-7f9d - Pod terminated: Node draining
I0314 18:15:24 proxy.go:88] 503 response outgoing for /v1/generate from 10.12.5.7
I0314 18:15:25 healthcheck.go:57] probe returned unhealthy -> reporting to monitoring
```

kevin: yep, confirm: drain -> healthcheck 503s -> PD pages. Fix options: 1) tighten dedupe/auto-grouping to group by service+error-class not by host; 2) add instance drain tag that incident-bot respects and suppresses; 3) revert last week's patch if it changed healthcheck behaviour.

james-support: enterprise-corp says latency spikes persisted for ~45s before recover. They saw no 5xxs on their side. We should capture span traces for that interval and let customer know we're investigating.

mohit: i'll pull traces. sara, can you also snapshot autoscaler events in the last 10m?

sara: autoscaler shows scaleDown at 18:15:20 for pool=ir-prod-pool, target -2. Manual drain initiated by cluster-autoscaler due to node underutilized.

mohit: cluster-autoscaler change -> drain timing aligned. That means legitimate noise, but we should suppress sensibly. Kevin, can the incident-bot be taught to ignore alerts tagged `node-drain`?

kevin: yes. PR plan: incident-bot should look for metadata `event:node-drain` and if present, aggregate and emit single page with `info: maintenance-like drain`. I can land a short-lived rule: if more than X alerts in Ys from same service and alerts contain `node-drain`, convert to advisory and do not escalate. Will open PR but will also add a backstop: if customer impact tag present, bypass suppression.

incident-bot: Action logged: suppression applied (mw_5a7b) by sara. Auto-grouping set to service+error-class. Temporary policy active until 1967890723.

mohit: I pulled traces — tail latency spike corresponds to one request hitting a pod in Terminating state, response served with long delay but non-500. That matches customer reports. Severity: degraded but partial. No widespread errors. Recommend: 1) keep maintenance window for 10m, 2) revert autoscaler scaleDown threshold tuning from last week to avoid aggressive drains, 3) file follow-up to improve bot dedupe.

james-support: I'll reply to enterprise-corp: acknowleged, transient latency during node drains, we mitigated and monitoring. Will offer postmortem if they want.

lucy: i'm coming on shift in 12m. please handoff current context so i can follow up if the suppression expires.

mohit: lucy — summary: pagerduty storm caused by node drain; maintenance mw_5a7b suppresses duplicate pages for 10m; no broad customer outage but some latency for enterprise-corp; followups: revert aggressive scaler, incident-bot dedupe PR, postmortem with root cause and customer-impact notes.

lucy: got it. i'll take over if anything flares after mw_5a7b. tagging this for postmortem. assigning to kevin for infra fix and to mohit for tracing/action items.

kevin: opening tickets: INFRA-2317 (revert scaleDown tuning), INFRA-2318 (incident-bot: node-drain suppression improvements). will include test plan to simulate drain and verify only single advisory page.

incident-bot: Reminder: maintenance mw_5a7b expires at 1967890723. If you need extended silence, extend the maintenance window.

mohit: thanks everyone. closing the live paging noise. will update thread if we see re-escalation. :white_check_mark:
